CustomField.description: Secondary line shown beneath the heading in the modal opened by a Start New Form or View/Edit Form Submission lookup override (#391). Left out entirely when blank. Applies only when referenceFormDisplayType__c is modal.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional subtitle displayed under the modal title, useful for a short instruction. Leave blank to show no subtitle. Has no effect when the display type is Inline.
CustomField.label: referenceFormModalSubheader
